content: Hudai Isi Mutun Udu Dao
Mexiha ingiezhi beyedene shouku giezhoma, taye imutu zhugheghala goyane ku shouikui zhunbei gie. Beyede shouku giesan kun zuise gonxi sirazho.
Ingiedene feiliesan udude kunni nefuxinyi pse ulie daghazhi Hudai isi mutun udu daone.
Ta daosandei niman kunla xiqi bikulai daghazhi hu gieku, nefuxin gieku, jiu ochizhi sudoku, lon naduzhi ochiku, nigiedalai beiizhi hanzhan gieghakui pse bu gie.
Ene shiqin jiere ta hhelare hhantu qingiezhi hashu witu lon ulie giekui hhela chanladene ghudurezhi tai sugiezho.
Jianlai hhela amitu kun, fugusan kunyi panjiku Ezhanyi melie zhan jiuine.
Ene yenyin jiere fugusan kunladeye gouxioxini chonjikushi beye miende hhelai kun mutun panjine giezhoma, ruhher miende Huda mutun amituraghane giezho.
Duya baraku ghujinlawo. Ingiese ta zhughesene xioxin giezhi jinxin giedene onxian gie.
Zui zhunyonishi nieniedene shixinde ore. Oreku olon zuini khazhi widaghane.
Ta bayasuku zhugheghala nieniene giedene goude jienlie.
Ta zhao Huda tande ogisan nenjien mutun nieniene ushilazhi Huda ogisan yanyanji nenjienni gou gonjia danla.

Jianjichenla indan Hudai kielienyi jianjikuni wo. Ushilachenla indan Huda ogisan lilianghala ushilakuni wo. Ingiese yan gieliuzhe Ersa Mexihai tungo giezhi Hudade kuaikui ireghane. Kuaiku, qienlini chanqi izhi hhende ogi. Amine.
Mexihani Tujini Shouku Gieku
Mii orentula, shiiku khan mutun tai jiere irese goyade yama shiqin penjiwo giezhi ghudure wo giezhi bu jindadene
Mexiha mutun hhere hhantu shouku giezho giezhi bayasundu. Ingiese Mexihai famatui khizheghakude ta hende bayasuzhi jiuline.
Mexihai yenyin jiere kunla tai sugiese tande fuqi wine. Famatu ruhher, yejiushi Hudai Ruhher tai jiere wo.
Tai dunda kienliuzhe kun alaku, ghulaku, doghun shiqin gieku, ulie gonjiku shiqinyi gonjikughala shouku bu gie.
Mexihani tuji danlazhi shouku giese bu shizhedene ene nierei yenyinzhe Hudai kuai.
Panjiku shihou kuzhewo. Hudai bexinse panjizhi qiine. Matanse kaishi giese gouxioxini ulie shunjisan kunlai jiego matui gholune?
Pse,

content.text: xienlian witu kun, zuirenla matui gholune?"

content: Ingiese Hudai isi mutun shouku giesan kunla izhi gouni giezhi duyai zhayaghasan kekaotu Ezhande goyane ogikui wo.
